matches.preview: The model sees this as a competitive encounter, with Everton favoured at 44%, though without clear conviction: the draw and Palace win both sit at 28%. Both endured disappointing concluding campaigns marked by losses and draws through spring. They drew 2-2 in May, with Everton holding a broader edge across recent head-to-head meetings. The goal market leans to under 2.5 at 52%, suggesting a cautious approach.
matches.preview_zh: 模型將此視為一場競爭激烈的對陣，Everton以44%被看好，儘管缺乏明確確信；平局和Crystal Palace勝利各佔28%。雙方都經歷了令人失望的賽季尾聲，春季期間充滿失利與平局。他們在五月打成2:2平，Everton在近期對陣中佔有更廣泛的優勢。進球傾向於2.5球以下，佔52%，暗示謹慎預期。

matches.preview: The model sees this as finely balanced, with Ipswich Town and Sunderland each at 36% probability and 29% for a draw. Ipswich return to the Premier League after a mixed Championship campaign last season. Sunderland, remaining at this level, showed patchy form in their previous term, with wins over Chelsea and Everton offset by a heavy defeat to Nott'm Forest. Ipswich's head-to-head record is notably strong, winning all four recent meetings. The model leans marginally towards under 2.5 goals at 52%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型認為這場比賽勢均力敵，Ipswich Town 和 Sunderland 各有 36% 的概率，平局為 29%。Ipswich 在上賽季英冠成績參差後重返英超。Sunderland 留在英超，上一個賽季表現不穩定，雖然贏過 Chelsea 和 Everton，但遭 Nott'm Forest 大敗。Ipswich 的歷史交手紀錄格外出眾，最近四場對陣全勝。模型略微傾向於 2.5 球以下，概率為 52%。

matches.preview: The model favours Nottingham Forest at home with a 41% probability against Leeds United's 31%, though the margin is modest. Last season these teams proved evenly matched in head-to-head contests, with Forest winning 3-1 away and Leeds responding with a 3-1 victory the following month. Both sides showed inconsistent form in their final matches, Forest accumulating draws and defeats while Leeds mixed wins with heavy losses. The goal market reflects this uncertainty precisely, with over and under 2.5 almost evenly split at 49% and 51% respectively.
matches.preview_zh: 模型認為Nottingham Forest主場對陣Leeds United更具優勢，概率為41%對31%，儘管優勢幅度並不明顯。上賽季兩隊在對陣中勢均力敵，Nottingham Forest曾以3:1客場戰勝Leeds United，隔月Leeds United隨即以3:1取勝作為回應。兩隊在最後幾場比賽中表現不穩定，Nottingham Forest以平局與敗績為主，而Leeds United則既有勝利也有慘敗。進球預測精確反映了這種不確定性，超過2.5球與不超過2.5球的概率分別為49%與51%。

matches.preview: The model rates this as closely matched: Brentford are marginal favourites at 40% to Tottenham's 34%, with the draw at 26%. At season's end last year, Brentford showed mixed form while Tottenham were more stable. Tottenham's head-to-head record offers encouragement: four wins in their past five meetings. Brentford's home displays lacked consistency, while Tottenham showed greater solidity. The model expects goals, with over 2.5 at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型評估這場比賽勢均力敵，Brentford以40%的概率略佔優勢，對比Tottenham的34%，平局為26%。上賽季末，Brentford表現起伏，Tottenham則較為穩定。Tottenham的近期交手成績令人鼓舞，過去五場比賽中贏得四場。Brentford的主場表現缺乏一致性，Tottenham則表現更為紮實。模型預期會有進球，超過2.5球的概率為57%。

matches.preview: Brighton holds the model's preference at 43% to Aston Villa's 30%, with a 26% draw probability suggesting a finely balanced contest. Last season Brighton demonstrated inconsistent home form, posting convincing 3-0 victories against Wolves and Chelsea offset by a 0-3 defeat to Manchester United. Aston Villa finished the campaign with stronger results, notably a 4-2 home victory over Liverpool and an away success at Manchester City. Recent meetings between the sides favour Villa, who took a 1-0 victory most recently and recorded a 3-0 success previously. The model indicates over 2.5 goals at 57%, pointing to attacking threats from both teams.
matches.preview_zh: Brighton模型預測為43%，相對於Aston Villa的30%，其中平局概率為26%，表示這是一場勢均力敵的比賽。上賽季Brighton主場表現不穩定，對Wolves和Chelsea取得令人印象深刻的3:0勝利，但被Manchester United以0:3擊敗。Aston Villa則以更強的成績結束賽季，包括主場以4:2擊敗Liverpool和客場擊敗Manchester City。雙方近期交手中Villa成績更優，最近以1:0勝利，之前還有過3:0的勝利。模型顯示進球數超過2.5球的概率為57%，反映兩隊都具有進攻威脅。

matches.preview: Manchester City are favoured at 65%, with the model clearly valuing their home advantage against this opponent. The sides drew 1-1 when they last met in May, with City having won three of the four meetings immediately before that. City's final matches last season were mixed, yielding three wins but also a home loss, whilst Bournemouth's closing fixtures featured consecutive draws. The model expects an open encounter, with over 2.5 goals predicted in 65 percent of simulations.

Liverpool are clear favourites at 48% to win, with Newcastle at 27% and the draw at 25%. They won 4-1 when the sides last met in January. Both clubs showed inconsistent form through the end of last season, with Newcastle winning twice at home before a late defeat, while Liverpool drew twice at Anfield in their closing matches. The model expects an open contest with over 2.5 goals at 64%, though both teams are returning from mixed late-season form.
matches.preview_zh: Liverpool 明顯為奪冠熱門，預測獲勝機率為 48%，Newcastle 為 27%，平局為 25%。兩隊上次在 1 月交手時，Liverpool 以 4 比 1 獲勝。兩支球隊在上賽季末段表現不穩定，Newcastle 主場連勝兩場後隨即遭遇一場敗績，而 Liverpool 在主場 Anfield 的最後幾場比賽則連賽兩平。模型預計本場將是一場開放式對陣，進球數超過 2.5 的機率為 64%，儘管兩支球隊都是在上賽季末段表現參差不齊的情況下回歸。

matches.preview: Chelsea are favoured at 47%, yet both Fulham's 27% and the draw's 26% clearly suggest that this will prove a genuinely competitive fixture. Fulham's previous campaign finished with notably strong form, particularly a commanding 2-0 home victory over Newcastle in May, whilst Chelsea's closing sequence proved inconsistent with just one win across their final six matches. The teams last met in January, when Fulham won 2-1 at home. Open, attacking play appears probable, with over 2.5 goals favoured at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: Chelsea的支持率為47%，不過Fulham的27%和平局的26%明確顯示這將是一場真正具有競爭力的比賽。Fulham的上一賽季以強勁的表現收尾，特別是在5月主場對Newcastle的2:0壓倒性勝利，而Chelsea的收尾階段表現不穩定，最後六場比賽中僅有一場勝利。兩隊上次在1月相遇，當時Fulham在主場以2:1勝出。比賽預計將出現開放式、進攻性的打法，2.5球以上的支持率為57%。
